entities.name: Avulsed permanent tooth first aid
observations: For an avulsed permanent tooth, replant it immediately when feasible; hold it by the crown, gently rinse visible debris, and seek urgent dental care. Storage in milk or another suitable medium is a fallback if immediate replantation is not possible.
